title: cgbookcase PBR textures
assetScope: Texture files published on cgbookcase; not website code, linked software or arbitrary third-party assets.
technicalNotes: Example asset provides Base Color, Height, DirectX Normal and Roughness maps; exact roles must be read per asset.
Channel-packed presets may use NormHeight or NormRough, not glTF metallic-roughness packing. Never infer packing from the presence of a packed map.
Record normal orientation explicitly. Native Kingmaker generated normals are OpenGL; imported DirectX maps need tested conversion or compatible shader handling.
Select individual resolution variants against transfer, storage and decoded texture-memory budgets. Streaming bytes does not make a large texture cheap to decode.
requiredBeforeDelivery: Select exact asset and resolution; retain source author, URL, reviewed license and download date.
Record hashes, byte sizes, map roles, color spaces and normal convention for all dependencies.
Obtain scoped source/transfer approval and independently bind rights evidence to the library entry.
Validate maps and target renderer before publishing or claiming compatibility.
